fields.name: Charles Otwere
fields.bio:
I am a graduate student in the MSc. Computer Information Systems & Business Analytics program at West Texas A&M University. My academic journey and professional experience reflect a consistent commitment to problem solving, strategic thinking, and organizational growth.

Before beginning my graduate studies, I built a solid career across marketing, sales, and product development roles in Ghana. I have served as a Marketing Manager, Sales & Product Development Manager, and Territory Supervisor in leading companies such as Kitea Ghana Limited, Assa Abloy, Sunda International, Wilmar Africa, and Unilever Ghana. Across these roles, I developed and executed data driven marketing strategies, managed distributors and wholesalers, optimized sales pipelines, and used market insights to improve product visibility and performance. These experiences strengthened my analytical mindset and my ability to translate data into actionable business decisions—skills that now support my transition into business analytics.

Alongside my professional experience, I have actively participated in research assistance, academic projects, and community leadership, including serving as a research assistant on multiple academic and professional projects, and as a youth leader involved in training and capacity development. My technical skills include data analysis (SPSS), Microsoft Office tools, and emerging information systems, which directly support my current academic focus.

Academically, I hold an MBA, and a Postgraduate Diploma in Marketing Management from Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, and a Bachelor of Science in Laboratory Technology from the University of Cape Coast, where my undergraduate research was published in the Asian Journal of Plant Science and Research (https://ir.ucc.edu.gh/xmlui/handle/123456789/5944 ). My research background has shaped my interest in evidence based decision making and structured analysis.

As my first project in WT, I designed and implemented an open-source Mailroom Management System, a secure and AI-featured package tracking platform designed for local community housing environments. I presented this work at our student research poster session in December 2025 and upgraded version in March 2026, where it was recognized by both faculty and peers. This project demonstrated my ability to utilize knowledge gained in the classroom to address real operational challenges within business scenarios.

Through my graduate studies, I have developed a blend of professional discipline, analytical curiosity, and a passion for continuous learning. My goal is to leverage my background in marketing, sales, and research—together with advanced training in CIS and Business Analytics—to contribute meaningfully to data driven decision making in organizations. 

I am particularly motivated by opportunities that allow me to apply creativity, problem solving, and technology to real world business challenges, particularly in areas such as inventory and project management, operational efficiency, and institutional decision support.

fields.title: Mailroom Management System
fields.description:
This project involved designing and deploying a fully functional Mailroom Dashboard for managing package deliveries and pickups in a residential setting. Built as part of the CIDM 4360 coursework at West Texas A&M University, the dashboard is a practical SaaS solution that streamlines mailroom operations, improves accountability, and enhances resident communication.

Project Overview
The Mailroom Dashboard was developed to address common challenges in residential package handling: tracking deliveries, identifying unknown recipients, and ensuring timely pickups. The system provides a centralized interface for mailroom staff to manage package status, log carrier details, and monitor resident interactions.

Key Features

1. Real-Time Package Tracking
Packages are categorized into:
- Pending Packages: Arrived but not yet picked up
- Unknown Packages: No matching resident found
- Received Packages: Successfully picked up and logged
Each entry includes carrier info, tracking number, arrival/pickup time, and actionable buttons (e.g., “Mark as Picked Up” or “Return Package”).

2. Summary Statistics
At the top of the dashboard, key metrics are displayed:
- Pending: 5
- Unknown: 2
- Received Today: 0
- Returned: 6
- Total Packages: 29
This gives staff a quick overview of mailroom activity and workload.

3. User-Friendly Navigation
The interface includes intuitive navigation for:
- Adding new packages
- Viewing unknown or returned items
- Accessing history and email notifications
The system is designed for speed and clarity, minimizing training time and maximizing operational efficiency.

4. Resident-Level Detail
Each package is tied to a specific resident and unit number, ensuring traceability and reducing the risk of mis-delivery. Unknown packages are flagged for resolution or return.

Impact
The Mailroom Dashboard delivers a clean, efficient, and scalable solution for residential package management. It demonstrates my ability to build production-grade interfaces, manage backend logic, and deploy real-world SaaS tools that solve operational problems. This project reflects my strengths in Django development, user experience design, and workflow optimization.

fields.title: CNAPY IMMS
fields.description:
The CNAPY Inventory Management System is a full‑featured administrative dashboard designed to streamline inventory tracking, purchasing workflows, and district‑level resource management. This project demonstrates my ability to build practical, data‑driven systems that support operational efficiency and real‑time decision‑making.

Project Overview
The goal of CNAPY was to create a centralized platform where administrators could monitor inventory levels, manage purchase records, track district requests, and maintain vendor relationships. The dashboard provides a clean, structured interface that makes it easy for users to navigate complex data and perform essential tasks with minimal friction.

Key Features

1. High‑Level System Summary
The dashboard opens with a snapshot of key metrics:
- 8 Total Districts
- 7 Inventory Items
- 6 Total Users
This gives administrators immediate visibility into the scale of operations.

2. Quick Action Controls
To support fast workflows, the system includes direct access to:
- Django Admin Panel
- View All Inventory
- Add New Item
- Manage Requests
- Add Storage Location
These shortcuts reduce navigation time and improve productivity.

3. Purchasing Management Module
A dedicated purchasing panel allows administrators to:
- Manage vendors
- Record purchases
- View purchase reports
- Add new vendors
This module centralizes procurement activities and ensures accurate record‑keeping.

4. Activity Monitoring
The dashboard highlights operational insights such as:
- Low stock alerts
- Today’s requests
- Weekly fulfillments
- Storage location count
These indicators help administrators anticipate needs and respond quickly.

5. Recent Activity Log
A real‑time activity table displays fulfilled requests across districts, including:
- District name
- Item requested
- Quantity
- Status
- Date
This ensures transparency and traceability across the entire inventory lifecycle.

🔑 Key Highlights:
Smart Workflow: Automated request processing with real-time stock updates
Multi-District Support: Centralized management with district-specific dashboards
RESTful API: Full integration capabilities for external systems
Role-Based Security: Admin, District, and Staff user permissions
Analytics Dashboard: KPI tracking and performance metrics
Mobile-Ready: Responsive design with API support

Impact
The CNAPY Inventory Management System provides a robust, scalable solution for managing educational district resources. It showcases my strengths in backend development, dashboard design, workflow optimization, and building systems that support real‑world administrative operations. This project reflects my ability to translate operational needs into intuitive, functional software.

fields.title: Monaak Services
fields.description:
For this project, I designed and developed the official website for Monaak Services, a marketing and brand‑activation agency specializing in experiential marketing, promotions, and creative branding solutions. The goal was to create a modern, visually engaging digital presence that clearly communicates the company’s value, capabilities, and service offerings.

Project Overview
Monaak Services needed a website that could position the brand as a high‑impact marketing partner while showcasing its diverse portfolio of experiential campaigns, promotional activations, and branding solutions. I focused on building a clean, intuitive interface supported by bold visuals, strong typography, and a vibrant color palette that reflects the company’s creative identity.
Key Features

1. Hero Section & Brand Messaging
The homepage opens with a strong headline — “We Create Unforgettable Brand Experiences” — supported by a dynamic gradient background. This instantly communicates the company’s mission and sets the tone for the rest of the site.

2. Clear Service Categories
I structured the service offerings into three core areas:
- Experiential Marketing: Roadshows, campus tours, mall activations, and consumer engagement events.
- Promotions & Activations: In‑store promotions, sampling, giveaways, and product launch campaigns.
- Branding & Prints: Creative design, advertising materials, banners, stickers, brochures, and corporate branding.
Each section includes concise descriptions to help visitors quickly understand what Monaak Services delivers.

3. “Why Choose Us” Value Proposition
To strengthen credibility, I added a dedicated section highlighting the company’s strengths:
- High‑impact brand activations
- Nationwide promotional execution
- Creative branding & advertising
- Accurate research & field data collection
This helps potential clients immediately see what sets the company apart.

4. Strong Calls to Action
Buttons like “Explore Services” and “Request a Quote” guide visitors toward taking action, improving lead generation and user engagement.

5. Visual‑Driven Layout
The site uses clean spacing, modern gradients, and service‑specific imagery to create a professional and memorable user experience.

Impact
The final website gives Monaak Services a polished digital identity that aligns with its mission: delivering creative, results‑driven marketing experiences. It enhances brand credibility, improves client engagement, and provides a strong foundation for future digital marketing efforts.

fields.title: CHARLES OTWERE
fields.description:
For this project, I designed and developed my personal portfolio website to serve as a central hub for showcasing my professional identity, technical skills, and completed work. The goal was to create a modern, engaging, and easy‑to‑navigate platform that reflects my experience as a Software Developer and Technology Enthusiast.

Project Overview
The portfolio was built to highlight my strengths across software development, business operations, and data‑driven problem‑solving. I wanted a digital space that not only presents my projects but also communicates my personality, work ethic, and the value I bring to organizations.
The homepage features a clean, bold layout with a professional portrait, a concise introduction, and clear calls to action. Visitors can quickly understand who I am, what I do, and how to connect with me.

Key Features
1. Strong Personal Branding
The landing section introduces me with a clear headline — “Hi, I’m Charles Otwere – Software Developer & Technology Enthusiast.”
This sets the tone for the entire site and positions me as a results‑driven professional who thrives at the intersection of technology and business.

2. Intuitive Navigation
The top navigation bar includes links to:
- About
- Projects
- Skills
- Experience
- Education
- Certifications
- Blog
- Testimonials
- Contact
This structure ensures that visitors can easily explore my background and work.

3. Professional Introduction
The homepage includes a short, compelling summary of my career focus — solving real‑world problems through technology, improving business operations, and delivering measurable results. This helps potential employers or clients quickly understand my value.

4. Clear Calls to Action
Buttons such as “View My Work” and “Get In Touch” guide visitors toward exploring my projects or contacting me directly. This improves engagement and supports networking or job‑search goals.

5. Integrated Social Presence
Social media icons (Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Reddit) are placed prominently to make it easy for visitors to connect with me across platforms.

Impact
This portfolio website has become a central part of my professional identity. It allows me to present my work in a polished, organized, and visually appealing way while reinforcing my credibility as a developer and technology professional. It also serves as a living document of my growth, updated regularly with new projects, skills, and achievements.

fields.name: Data, AI, and the Next Wave of Innovation
fields.description:
Technology is moving faster than ever, and the biggest shifts today are happening at the intersection of data and artificial intelligence. Every week brings a new breakthrough - smarter models, more powerful tools, and fresh ways businesses can turn information into impact.

One of the most exciting trends is the rise of AI‑driven automation. Companies are no longer just collecting data; they’re using AI to analyze it, predict outcomes, and automate decisions in real time. From customer insights to supply‑chain optimization, AI is becoming the engine behind smarter operations.

At the same time, data quality and governance are becoming critical. As organizations adopt more AI tools, they’re realizing that models are only as good as the data feeding them. This has pushed data engineering, analytics, and responsible AI practices to the center of modern tech strategy.

We’re also seeing rapid growth in AI‑assisted development — tools that help developers write code faster, debug more efficiently, and build applications with fewer barriers. This shift is reshaping what it means to be a developer and accelerating innovation across the industry.

Overall, the momentum in tech is clear:
AI is becoming more accessible, data is becoming more valuable, and the companies that embrace both are pulling ahead. This is an exciting time to be in the field — and the next wave of innovation is only just beginning.

fields.title: Faculty and Student Research Poster Session and Research Fair
fields.description:
Traditional mailroom operations in residential settings often rely on manual logging, paper-based tracking, and inconsistent communication. These inefficiencies can lead to lost packages, delayed pickups, and poor tenant satisfaction. This project leverages modern web technologies, AI, and middleware design to address these gaps through automation, observability, and secure data handling.
We aim to transform routine administrative processes into a data-driven, efficient model by developing an affordable, scalable, and customizable open-source Mailroom Management System. Our Django-based solution will empower smaller residential operators with modern digital tools to enhance speed, traceability, and resident satisfaction.

Core Technology:
Django web framework (MVT architecture) and relational database and chatbot assistance services.

Key Features:
AI-assisted package intake and automated email notifications with secure QR-based pickup.
Basic AI chatbot support to check package status.
Role-based dashboards for residents and staff.
Audit logging and robust error handling for reliability.
Support for known and unknown recipients (flexibility).

Design Principles:
Usability: Simple, user-centered interfaces requiring minimal training.
Security: CSRF protection, secure sessions, input validation to protect resident data.
Scalability: Supports large databases, multiple users, and future integrations (mobile apps, carrier APIs).
Reliability: Ensures accurate recordkeeping and prevents data loss.
Flexibility: Adapts to incomplete resident information.
Object-Oriented Design: Applied OOP principles for maintainability, modularity, and future enhancements.

fields.title: COB First Student Research Poster Session
fields.description: This project presents a secure, scalable Django-based Mailroom Management System for university housing and leasing offices. The system automates package workflows using OCR for label scanning and chatbot assistance while maintaining reliability through audit logging and robust security controls. This project practically demonstrates how modern web technologies can be effectively applied to solve real-world operational challenges and improve mailroom efficiency
